knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson requires a breach to be reported to the designated contact immediately and the facts recorded. Hoping the recipient does not notice (option 0) and sending the correct details to the wrong person as well (option 2) make the breach worse.

The lesson says customer information is kept in the approved system and not copied to personal devices or accounts. A personal phone (option 0) and a personal cloud account (option 2) are the forbidden locations.
The lesson says not to discuss one customer's information with another, and not to leave documents or screens visible in a customer's home.

practicalCriteria: Learner identifies the personal information in a supplied job scenario and keeps only what the job needs.
Learner checks the recipient before sending a supplied document and sends only what that person needs.
Learner reports a simulated misdirected message to the designated contact immediately and records the facts and actions taken.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Breach record with facts, information involved, actions taken and people notified
Record of any access or deletion request handled through the approved channel
stopWorkCriteria: Learner keeps customer photographs or details on a personal device or account
Learner sends personal information to an unchecked recipient
